why: A (universes 0): Lemma 11.A on a slice submanifold. For ω ∈ Ω(N; p, q) and a piecewise smooth family of linear maps Λ(t) : P → T_{ω(t)}N (ANY normed parameter space P) with Λ(0) = Λ(1) = 0, Milnor's formula α(u, t) = exp_{ω(t)}(Λ(t) u) is a variation of ω on a ball ‖u‖ < ε with α(0, t) = ω(t) and Fréchet derivative ∂α/∂u(0, t) = Λ(t) (exists_variation); specialised to u • W(t) on |u| < ε with variation field W (exists_variation_one) and to u₁ W₁(t) + u₂ W₂(t) with partial derivatives W₁, W₂ (exists_variation_two). B: for an abstract Riemannian manifold with a Milnor-Levi-Civita connection, pw ∈ Ω and W ∈ TΩ_pw: (1) some 1-parameter variation of pw has variation field W; (2) for some ε > 0, Milnor's formula α(u, t) = exp_{pw t}(u W_t) (blind expMap, with ExpDefined asserted) on t ∈ [0, 1] is such a variation on the ball |u| < ε; (3) for W₁, W₂ ∈ TΩ_pw some 2-parameter variation of pw has fields W₁, W₂. A ⇒ B fails genuinely: B's manifold is abstract with an arbitrary IsLC connection and its exp is the blind one, A's exp is the induced one on a slice submanifold. B ⇒ A fails: A's exists_variation (arbitrary normed P, linear family Λ, Fréchet derivative) and the explicit exp-formula of the 2-parameter case (exists_variation_two) are not in B, whose (3) only asserts the existence of some 2-parameter variation; transporting (2) to exists_variation_one would additionally need the variation/varField/pathTangent dictionary missing from Bridge (as in V8_2) and Bridge.expMap_eq together with the converse mem_expDom_of_expDefined (now in V7_29.lean). On the common core — the 1-parameter formula exp_{ω(t)}(uW_t) — the two statements agree.
B_issue: Clauses (1)–(3) require `∀ t, HEq (W t) (varField α i t)` for ALL real t, not only t ∈ [0, 1]: off [0, 1] neither IsVar nor InTOmega constrains α or W, so a proof must extend the variation off [0, 1] so that u ↦ α u t has velocity W t there (possible, e.g. through a chart at pw t, but it is not Milnor's statement and is stronger than (2)'s formula, which is only required for t ∈ [0, 1]). Not false, only awkward; the verdict is unaffected since no direction is proved.
harness_note: B uses ExpDefined/expMap (Riemannian geodesics) and no norm; it does not use nrm/tball/IsNormBall/IsUniformNormal, so the chart-norm defect of the prelude does not affect it.
embedded_special_case_note: Needs the variation dictionary of V8_2 plus the exp dictionary (Bridge.expMap_eq and V7_29.mem_expDom_of_expDefined); then B(2) ⇒ exists_variation_one and A ⇒ B(1), (2), (3) for Sub hN should be straightforward.
